about: Which Doman-Digital repos get the tooling automerge rule in default.json: every unarchived repo with the dd-tooling topic, minus the exclusions below. test/renovate-tooling.test.mjs checks default.json against this file; scripts/check-renovate-tooling.mjs checks it against GitHub topics every day from renovate.yml. Founder yes, 17 November 2026: green robot PRs on our own tooling merge themselves, client sites never.

excluded.client-previews: builds client preview sites; a broken update shows only at a manual production deploy, so a person merges
excluded.dd-ci-standards: every merge moves @v1 for the whole estate, so a person picks a quiet moment
